title: Quadratic Equation Solver
description: Solve for the roots of a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0.

faqs.question: What if the discriminant is negative?
faqs.answer: The equation has complex roots, shown in the form a + bi.

faqs.question: What if a is 0?
faqs.answer: The equation is no longer quadratic — a linear equation solver would be needed instead.
